cohort: 200 pregnant women with a BMI >25 kg/m^2 and gestational age up to 20 weeks.
finding: Overweight and obese pregnant women had an increased frequency of maternal and fetal complications.
mod_finding: The rate of instrumental delivery was 6.5%, while the cesarean section rate was 38%.
followup_time: Through the postnatal period (timeframe not explicitly stated)
birth_weight: Low birth weight (5.5%) and macrosomia (13%) were reported, but specific birth weight ranges were not provided.
